protocol.kind: Exploratory fixed-window native activity census; no model learning
protocol.selection: Quarter and three-quarter document indexes of new reading, binding and narrative training groups; centered window up to 257 bytes per document. Same six windows for every model.
protocol.pooled_weighting: Each observed byte contributes once; window lengths differ and are recorded.
protocol.limits: No fresh-model learning curve, no causal plasticity diagnosis, no pruning or renewal. Tiny reset-state samples cannot establish general activity or task importance.
